newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Sept skilled vacancies fall 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Sept skilled vacancies fall 0.7 pct.

text.p: The Australian government's index of skilled job vacancies fell 0.7 percent in September, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The skilled vacancies index fell to 141, 0.7 percent lower than in August, the department said in a statement.
"Decreases were recorded in eight of the 16 occupational groups, five groups increased and three remained unchanged," the department said.
The biggest falls were 3.6 percent in building trades, 3.1 percent for computer professionals, 2.3 percent for business professionals and 2.2 percent in vehicle trades.
The largest increases were 3.2 percent for nurses, 3.0 percent for natural scientists and 2.2 percent in the electrical and electonics group.

Four states and the Northern Territory recorded falls, with the territory dropping 5.1 percent, Victoria and New South Wales states 2.3 percent each, Western Australia 0.8 percent and Queensland 0.7 percent.
Tasmania's index increased 7.3 percent and South Australia's 4.4 percent.
The national index is 110.4 percent above the recession low of 67 recorded in mid-1991, the department said.
